instruction: Create a pie chart from the spreadsheet's 2019 annual totals in row 15, showing costs divided by category: Gas & Electric, Internet Access, Mobile Bill, Council Tax, Car Insurance, Food Bill, TV Licence/Netflix.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a pie chart from 2019 annual totals (row 15: Gas=515, Internet=372, Mobile=120, Council=1140, Car=540, Food=1745, TV=276). The evaluator checks if the file contains a pie chart. Verified data structure: Row 15 contains the annual totals for all categories in 2019.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 40% for chart existence, 60% for correct chart type (pie)

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all instruction requirements - chart type (pie), data source (row 15), category count (7), and specific category names
Correct data source verification: Getter extracts data_row from chart data range (e.g., $B$15:$H$15) and metric validates it matches expected row 15
Correct category verification: Getter extracts actual category labels from chart's category range and metric validates all 7 expected categories are present (case-insensitive)
Logical correctness: Getter parses chart data range and category range correctly using openpyxl, extracting row numbers and cell values
Proper scoring logic: Chart type is required (returns 0.0 if wrong), optional checks (data_row, category_count, categories) contribute to partial scoring
Expected values are semantically correct: chart_type='pie', data_row=15, category_count=7, categories match instruction requirements
Postconfig is appropriate: Activates window and saves file before reading chart data
